Biblical counseling is not a substitute for medical or clinical care. If you or someone you know is in crisis or danger, call your local emergency number or, in the U.S., call or text 988.
entries.description: Marriage guide arguing that couples need changed expectations, radical commitments and grace, built around six commitments including confession and forgiveness, building trust and appreciating differences.
